parts.text: Another club has N members. The fee for each member is $F. x members leave the club. The club increases the fee for each member by $y.

content.tex: Another club has \(N\) members. The fee for each member is \(\$F.\)
\(x\) members leave the club. The club increases the fee for each member by \(\$y.\)

parts.text: (a) (i) Write down an expression for the total fees before the increase in the fee. ................................................. [1]

parts.text: (c) 20 members leave the club. The club increases the fee for each member by $10 so that the total fees in part (a)(i) stay the same. Find a model for N in terms of F. ................................................. [3]
